description:
Advances: ancora.gate, ancora.tasks

Stage: L9 (05a-stages-library.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu.

Deliverable:
Ancora.Gate (spec.check orchestration over the seven-stage pipeline: preflight, corpus, change set, derivation, compare, findings, output), Ancora.Gate.Preflight (git repo present; base resolvable; umbrella via ProjectInfo; no .app or dev-build check exists), mix spec.check (flags --base, --verbose, --debug, --root, --spec-dir, --json; full report map via Jason with the verdict line still last), mix spec.validate (--strict, --debug, --root, --spec-dir). Missing-base hard-fail message names git fetch origin main, --base <ref>, and default_base. All task error paths route through Output.gated. Mix bootstrap posture: tasks require deps.loadpaths and never compile the target project; cold-checkout first-run behavior documented in the task moduledoc. Ancora.Json utility. Diff-scoping integration: acknowledgment clears drift/growth/shrink; Spec-Ack trailer downgrades; brand-new subject self-clears; change/uncovered_file and change/missing_decision wired; strict verdict semantics.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged_tests covering ancora.gate.preflight_hard_fails, default_base_no_fallback, diff_scoped_versus_repo_state, acknowledgment_clears, new_subject_self_clears, unanchored_subject, change_findings, strict_verdict, no_derived_state; ancora.tasks.gated_emission_paths, check_flags, validate_flags, exit_codes, mix_bootstrap_posture; ancora.findings.info_visibility
- Behaviors to demonstrate: the five subprocess goldens via System.cmd("mix", ...) in warmed fixture projects with stdout and stderr captured separately: ancora.tasks.scenario.green_golden, findings_golden, env_golden, usage_golden, internal_raise_has_no_verdict (asserts the verdict line is ABSENT), plus json_golden, config_diagnostic_on_stderr, no_validate_status_line, validate_rejects_output, no_project_compile; ancora.gate.scenario.missing_base_hard_fails, base_head_is_legal, not_a_git_repo, drift_cleared_by_spec_edit, trailer_downgrades_not_silences, new_subject_clears_itself, unanchored_every_run, override_silences_one_subject, uncovered_lib_file, governance_change_without_adr, warning_fails_check_not_validate, empty_corpus_is_green, no_output_flag_on_gate_tasks; ancora.findings.scenario.info_hidden_by_default
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or named files plus mix spec.check --base HEAD once the task runs; no full suite mid-iteration
  - Final tier: the four common merge-gate commands run-until-green before IMPLEMENTED
  - Verifier tier: tagged tests for the ids above plus --stale only; the subprocess goldens are in scope for the verifier
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface: consumer CI (shared workflow, post-shim) and the agent loop call mix spec.check; the replay harness (M1) calls --json; proving tests are the goldens here
  - Fixture hygiene: fixture projects under test/fixtures/projects are warmed once per suite, never committed with _build; git repos for diff cases built at runtime
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable/config surface
  - Every conditional clause covered (each preflight check, each gated branch, each flag rejection)
- Call-site Integration: production callers are consumer CI and the agent loop; proving tests are the subprocess goldens, which exercise the contract exactly as those callers consume it. --json production caller is the replay harness (M1); proving test is the JSON golden here plus the harness self-test.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/{prime,next,status,review}*, lib/mix/tasks/spec.{prime,next,status,review,init,decision.new}.ex (L10-L12)
- lib/ancora/derive/** (read-only here)
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- lib/ancora/gate.ex, lib/ancora/gate/preflight.ex, lib/ancora/change_analysis.ex, lib/ancora/json.ex, lib/ancora.ex (validate/3 facade)
- lib/mix/tasks/spec.check.ex, lib/mix/tasks/spec.validate.ex
- test/ancora/gate*_test.exs, test/mix/tasks/spec_{check,validate}_test.exs, test/ancora/golden/**, test/fixtures/projects/**, test/support/**
- .spec/specs/ancora.gate.spec.md, .spec/specs/ancora.tasks.spec.md (acknowledging edits to requirement/scenario blocks only; never weakening)

Out of Scope (intent):
- no base fallback ladder; no .app precondition; no --output on check/validate
- no retired flags accepted (--no-run-commands, --min-strength, --command-timeout-ms, --accept-drift, --test-tags, --run-commands)
- no project compilation triggered by any task
- when widening a shared helper, check every caller (retro class 2)

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.check --base HEAD runs in this repo and emits a verdict line (smoke; subjects still draft)
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
title: L9: Gate assembly (spec.check, spec.validate, --json)
